subject: [hw] DONE V18 rev 2 (test coverage strengthened, implementation unchanged)
body:
Rev 2 is test-only: the implementation of emu/n2a32_neon_3same.c is unchanged since DONE V18.

What changed: the generated shift cases now use the eight boundary shift counts {0, 1, es-1, -(es-1), es, -es, es+1, -(es+1)} for every element size (8/16/32/64) instead of a pseudo-random sample, and gen_cases.py asserts that coverage (it fails the build otherwise). Before this, esize 64 forms did not exercise +/-63/64/65 because the sample only hit 17 of 32 counts. Same total: 332 forms, 2656 generated + 134 golden cases.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/run_tests.sh (ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2, identical):
    V18: 2790 cases, 2949 oracle words, sweep ok=56088 undef=164908
    N2TEST V18 PASS 225740/225740
    V18-IOS n2a32_neon_3same.c compiles for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with zero warnings
    V18-VENDOR PASS every class mnemonic used by the vendor objects is implemented

Also since rev 1 (no code change): replied to hw-t01 on the five arm-O2 kernel failures with the per-kernel isolation (every kernel containing only V18-class instructions has 0 mismatches in all four ARM configurations; k_neon_vsubl, which has no V18 instruction, fails 20/20 at arm-O2; k_u8_sad hinges on V20 lane-load upper-lane contents), and to hw-d01 with the V18 census split. STATUS.md updated in emu/test_v18/ and dsh-state/workers/V18/. Still available for review findings.
